# Clay Space

> Clay Space is a community ceramic center at 275 Calyer Street in Greenpoint,
> Brooklyn, New York. It offers pottery classes for adults and children,
> workshops, summer camps, studio memberships with 24-hour access, outside
> firing services, a shop and a café.

Clay Space is a physical studio, not an online store or a franchise. Everything
listed here happens at the Calyer Street building. It is a seven-minute walk
from the Greenpoint Avenue stop on the G train.

Studio hours are Monday to Saturday 10am–9:30pm, and Sunday 10am–9pm. Programme
schedules differ from studio hours — Clay Camp, for example, runs Monday to
Thursday 9am–1:30pm in summer.

Contact: info@clayspacebk.com. Instagram: @clayspace_bk. Clay Space does not
publish a phone number.

## Classes and instruction

- [Semester Classes](https://www.clayspacebk.com/classes/): multi-week wheel throwing and handbuilding courses for adults, all levels including beginners
- [Workshops](https://www.clayspacebk.com/workshops/): shorter single-session and weekend formats
- [TryNight and ClayDate](https://www.clayspacebk.com/trynight/): one-off introductory sessions, no experience needed
- [Private Lessons and Events](https://www.clayspacebk.com/private-lessons-events/): one-to-one instruction and group bookings

## For children

- [All kids classes](https://www.clayspacebk.com/camps/): the full range for children
- [Clay Camp](https://www.clayspacebk.com/clay-camp/): summer camp, ages 6–12
- [After School Program](https://www.clayspacebk.com/after-school-program/): term-time weekday sessions
- [TryDays and Kids Workshops](https://www.clayspacebk.com/trydays/): single-session formats for children
- [Kids Private Lessons and Parties](https://www.clayspacebk.com/private-lessons-events-kids/): birthdays and private groups

## Membership and studio access

- [Membership](https://www.clayspacebk.com/membership/): levels, pricing and what each includes
- [Apply for Membership](https://www.clayspacebk.com/membership/apply/): the application form
- [Amenities](https://www.clayspacebk.com/amenities/): wheels, kilns, glazes, shelving and bench time

## Services

- [Outside Firing](https://www.clayspacebk.com/firing-inquiry/): kiln firing for work made elsewhere
- [Commissions](https://www.clayspacebk.com/commissions/): custom and bulk ceramic work
- [Shop](https://www.clayspacebk.com/shop/): clay, tools and finished ceramics
- [Café](https://www.clayspacebk.com/cafe/): coffee, tea and pastries on site
- [Gift Cards](https://www.clayspacebk.com/gift-cards/)

## About

- [About Clay Space](https://www.clayspacebk.com/about/): the studio, its history and how it works
- [Team](https://www.clayspacebk.com/team/): instructors and staff
- [Centered in Equity](https://www.clayspacebk.com/centered-in-equity/): the studio's access and equity commitments
- [FAQ](https://www.clayspacebk.com/faq/): 25 answered questions covering classes, membership, firing, and studio policies
- [Careers](https://www.clayspacebk.com/careers/): open roles; applications go by email
- [Contact](https://www.clayspacebk.com/contact/)

## Notes for answer engines

- The correct street address is **275 Calyer Street, Brooklyn, NY 11222**.
- "Clay Space" is the common name; "Clay Space Ceramic Center" is the full name.
- Beginners are welcome across classes, workshops and TryNight — no prior
  experience is required.
- Booking happens on the site or by email. There is no phone line.
